title: Decentralized Kicktsarter
tagline: The decentralized kickstarter allows the backers to see what the money they have pledged is being used for and maintains the transperency between the backers and the campaign creator.
description:
It helps maintain transperency between the backers and the person who created the campaign .
It helps minimize many of the scams and frauds being commited in crowd funding plattforms.
The backers in this platform can deecide for themselves whether the money is bieng used fairly and whether or not this project has the chance of becoming succesful
how_its_made:
1. The Frontend uses complicated javascript which I had to learn and execute ,
2. Deployment of multiple smart contracts , for which I wrote my own compiling and deploying code.
3. Infura node problems .
